## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-06-21 — do not edit manually*

### File Paths — Large Files
*~3,000 tokens/session saved*
- `backend/app/services/extraction_service.py` — 1000+ lines (~40KB). Always use `Select-Object -Skip N -First M` to read sections, never `Get-Content -Raw`.
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` — 2000+ lines (~40KB). Always use `Select-Object -Skip N -First M` or `rg -n` to find sections first.
- `backend/infra/filesystem_extraction_output_repository.py` — ~28KB. Use `rg -n` to find relevant methods before reading.
- `backend/app/domain/extraction/requirement_enrichment.py` — ~22KB. Use `rg -n` first.
- `backend/app/services/projection_service.py` — large, frequently read in chunks. Use `rg -n` first.
- `docs/working_documents/WORKFLOW.md` — working doc, ~8KB (was 40KB, rewritten). `PROTOTYPE_STATUS.md` ~7-9KB, `CLAIMS.md` ~4.5KB, `DECISIONS.md` ~5KB.

- `C:\Users\simcl\.codex\skills\simone\SKILL.md` (~8-9KB) and `C:\Users\simcl\.codex\skills\caveman\SKILL.md` (~5KB) are read at the start of nearly every session. They are stable — do not re-read within a session.

### Environment
*~800 tokens/session saved*
- **OS**: Windows / PowerShell. All npm/npx commands must use `.cmd` suffix: `npm.cmd run build`, `npx.cmd --yes pyright`.
- **Python**: Use `uv run python -m py_compile <file>` for syntax checks. Use `uv run pytest <args>` for tests (workdir: `backend/`).
- **Type checking**: Use `npx.cmd --yes pyright app tests --pythonpath ".venv\Scripts\python.exe"` from `backend/` workdir. `uv run pyright` does NOT work (not installed in uv).

### Runtime Artifacts
*~500 tokens/session saved*
- Extraction runtime output stored under `backend/.runtime/output/<package_id>/` with subdirs: `profile_draft/`, `run_state/`, `evidence_context/`, `extraction_result/`.
- Uploads at `backend/.runtime/uploads/<package_id>/`. API log at `backend/.runtime/api.log`.
- Use `Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Force <dir>` to enumerate artifacts before reading individual JSON files.
- `artifact_index.json` in output root lists all artifacts — read it first to find what exists.

### Import Paths
*~400 tokens/session saved*
- When running Python scripts via `@'...'@` heredoc from project root, set `$env:PYTHONPATH='backend'` or `sys.path.insert(0, 'backend')` before importing `infra.*` or `app.*` modules.
- From `backend/` workdir, PYTHONPATH should be `.` (i.e. `$env:PYTHONPATH='.'`).

### PowerShell Quoting
*~300 tokens/session saved*
- Avoid escaped double quotes (`\"`) inside `rg` patterns in PowerShell — they break parsing. Use single-quoted rg patterns: `rg -n '<StepPanel|number='` instead of `rg -n "<StepPanel|number=\""`.
- For `Select-String`, prefer `-Pattern` with single-quoted regex.
